groups.description: Advanced page actions: find element by intent, typeahead pick, coordinate click, drag, fill form.
Page capabilities and devtools: JS dialogs, local file upload, console messages, network request metadata.
Browser core operations on a real Chrome tab: open/attach/close tabs, navigate, observe, click, type, select, press keys, scroll, wait, read text, screenshot, hover, risk advice.
DSH Host Ops: list/start sessions; send vs steer vs queue; wait/notify; read/search/archive/rename sessions; manage workspaces; edit DSH config.
Reminders: create, list, view or edit scheduled prompts for this session.
Goal tracking: create, read or update the session goal.
Persistent terminals: open, send input, read output, signal, close, list sessions.
Search and trace prior sessions/events in this workspace (full-text search, lineage, event read).
Exhibits workspace tools: create, update, list, export and open exhibits; collect feedback.
DSH plugin development and live inspection: install/update/remove plugin bundles; inspect services, config schemas, tools, UI slots and themes.
Workflow runner: execute a multi-step orchestration script across subagents.
Miscellaneous local tools: CUA computer use, ralph loops, worktree creation, channel workers, subagent model listing, propose_action.
